categories.heading: Support categories
categories.intro: Create and organize the categories users choose from when opening a support ticket.
categories.empty: No categories yet. Create one to get started.
categories.delete_confirm_named: Delete the category “{name}”? This can't be undone.
categories.delete_confirm_with_tickets: This category still has {count} ticket(s). Deleting it will also delete those tickets. Continue?

category_editor.field_slug_help: Used in the category's URL. Leave blank to generate it from the name.
category_editor.field_color_help: Hex color (e.g. #3b82f6) used for the category's badge.
category_editor.field_icon_help: A Font Awesome class, e.g. fas fa-life-ring.
category_editor.field_position_help: Categories are ordered by this value, lowest first.
category_editor.field_is_appeal_help: Tickets opened in this category are treated as ban appeals.
category_editor.field_default_assignee_help: New tickets in this category are assigned to this person, and only they are notified about them. Leave it on "Nobody" to notify every staff member instead and let whoever replies first pick the ticket up.
category_editor.field_default_assignee_error: Couldn't load the list of staff. The current setting is unchanged.
category_editor.error_save: Couldn't save the category. Please check the fields and try again.

appeal_bans.intro: Control which users are blocked from filing ban appeals.
appeal_bans.banned_empty: No users are currently banned from filing appeals.

navigation.heading: Navigation
navigation.intro: Where the Support link appears, and what the sidebar shows on support pages.
navigation.in_sidebar: Show the Support link in the forum sidebar
navigation.in_sidebar_help: The link that sits with All Discussions and Tags. Members only either way: guests cannot open a ticket.
navigation.in_account_menu: Show the Support link in the account menu
navigation.in_account_menu_help: The menu under your avatar, alongside Profile and Settings.
navigation.forum_nav: Show the forum's navigation on support pages
navigation.forum_nav_help: When on, support pages also list All Discussions, Following and Tags above the ticket filters. Off by default, so support pages show only the tickets.

saved_replies.heading: Saved replies
saved_replies.intro: Common answers staff can insert into a ticket reply from the composer, then edit before sending. Only staff see them.
saved_replies.field_title_help: What staff pick from the list, for example "Need your forum URL".
saved_replies.field_content_help: Inserted into the reply exactly as written. Markdown and BBCode work as they do in any reply.
saved_replies.field_position_help: Optional. Lower numbers come first; the rest follow alphabetically.
saved_replies.error_save: Could not save the saved reply.

auto_close.heading: Reminders and automatic closing
auto_close.intro: Close tickets that stay Resolved with no further activity. A reply from either side reopens a resolved ticket, so this only closes tickets nobody came back to. Nobody is notified; the ticket history shows it was closed automatically, and the owner can still reopen it.
auto_close.days_help: Counted from when the ticket was resolved or last replied to, whichever is later. Set to 0 to turn this off. Runs once an hour, and needs the Flarum scheduler (php flarum schedule:run) set up in cron.
auto_close.reminder_days_help: When a ticket has been waiting on its owner (Awaiting response) this long with no activity, they get one reminder by notification and email. Once per wait. Set to 0 to turn this off.

rate_limits.heading: Rate limits
rate_limits.intro: Limit how often users can open support tickets and ban appeals.
rate_limits.max_general_per_window_help: How many general support tickets a user may open within the window below.
rate_limits.general_window_hours_help: The rolling time window, in hours, for the general ticket limit.
rate_limits.max_appeals_per_window_help: How many ban-appeal tickets a user may open within the appeal window.
rate_limits.appeal_window_days_help: The rolling time window, in days, for the appeal limit.
rate_limits.max_concurrent_appeals_help: How many appeal tickets a user may have open at the same time.
